title: Lost Mary Blueberry Rose Mint 10ml Nic Salts E-Liquid
description: Lost Mary Blueberry Rose Mint 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid offers a beautifully delicate and highly unique fruit and botanical profile. This expertly balanced blend leads with the sweet, juicy taste of ripe Blueberries to create a rich fruit foundation. As the flavour develops, subtle and fragrant notes of floral Rose weave through the profile, adding a sophisticated layer of depth. Finally, a crisp Mint finish washes over the palate, providing a cool and refreshing exhale that beautifully contrasts the initial sweetness. Available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg nicotine strengths, this premium nicotine salt formulation ensures rapid delivery and a smooth, comfortable throat sensation to effectively manage nicotine intake. The balanced 50VG/50PG ratio provides an ideal combination of clear, intense flavour and discreet vapour production. Lost Mary Nic Salts are designed specifically to perform reliably with low-wattage mouth-to-lung hardware, including refillable pod vape kits and classic starter vape kits. The Lost Mary Nic Salts collection delivers the same intense and globally popular flavours that made their single-use devices famous, now in a convenient 10ml refillable format. Beyond the elegant floral notes of Blueberry Rose Mint, vapers can explore other vibrant options within the range, such as the crisp orchard bite of Double Apple or the bright, zesty tang of Orange Juice. It is the perfect choice for those seeking a premium, flavour-packed experience in a more cost-effective format. Compatible with refillable pod vape or vape starter kit UK devices for smooth hits.
